what: Create World, all five steps (the p2-create run in English): words only, no name → Write the world; lock the look card, rewrite the 6 unlocked cards; Continue to the look: 3 pictures, choose sketch 2 (sha256 in the page); Continue to the story; Continue to build: the quote; Build and play; the published assets/look.png vs the chosen picture
start: Create → Start a new game already open (the idea step), UI English, content language en-US (the default after the UI switch), play style Explore (default)

actions.type: Fog-bound drifting islands where islanders send cargo by kite, and lamps are lit each dusk to guide lost kites home.

actions.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const p=document.querySelector('[data-stream-preview=world]'); if(p&&p.innerText.length>40)return {atMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0,text:p.innerText.slice(0,200)}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));} return 'no world stream preview';})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const p=document.querySelector('[data-stream-preview=world]'); if(p&&p.innerText.length>40){p.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return {atMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.rw0,text:p.innerText.slice(0,200)};} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));} return 'no stream preview';})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<480;i++){if(!document.querySelector('[data-stream-preview]') && ![...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Cancel')) return {rewriteMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.rw0}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return 'still running';})()

({drawing: document.body.innerText.match(/Drawing \d sketch[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null, storyHeader: document.body.innerText.match(/Writing the story[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null, story: document.querySelector('[data-stream-preview=story]')?.innerText.slice(0,200) ?? null})

(async()=>{const seen={}; let storyReady=null; for(let i=0;i<720;i++){const n=document.querySelectorAll('[data-look-pictures] img').length; if(!(n in seen)) seen[n]=Date.now()-window.__e2e.look0; if(storyReady===null){const m=document.body.innerText.match(/The story is ready: \d+ chapters?\./); if(m) storyReady={atMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.look0, line:m[0]};} if(n>=3) return {picturesAtMs:seen, storyReady}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return {seen, body: document.body.innerText.slice(0,400)};})()
({usage: document.querySelector('[data-usage-line]')?.innerText, storyReady: document.body.innerText.match(/The story is ready[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null})

(async()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-look-pictures] button')].find(x=>x.innerText.includes('Chosen look')); const src=b.querySelector('img').src; const bin=atob(src.slice(src.indexOf(',')+1)); const u=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); const h=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',u); window.__e2e.chosenSha=[...new Uint8Array(h)].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(''); return {labels:[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-look-pictures] button')].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()), bytes:u.byteLength, sha256:window.__e2e.chosenSha};})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<480;i++){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==='Continue to build'); if(b&&!b.disabled) return {storyWaitMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.story0, chapters:[...document.body.innerText.matchAll(/Chapter (\d)/g)].map(m=>m[1])}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.body.innerText.slice(0,400);})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<80;i++){const q=document.querySelector('[data-quote]'); if(q&&q.innerText.includes('This draft')) return q.innerText; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.querySelector('[data-quote]')?.innerText ?? 'no quote';})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<480;i++){if(/Your world is published/.test(document.body.innerText)){window.__e2e.publishedAt=Date.now(); return {buildToPublishedMs: window.__e2e.publishedAt-window.__e2e.build0, panel: document.body.innerText.slice(0,500)};} const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); if(S.useSessionStore.getState().screen==='play') return 'went straight to play'; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.body.innerText.slice(0,600);})()

(async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); for(let i=0;i<960;i++){const s=S.useSessionStore.getState(); if(s.screen==='play'&&s.activeInstance){window.__e2e.playAt=Date.now(); return {buildMs:window.__e2e.playAt-window.__e2e.build0, enterToPlayMs:window.__e2e.playAt-window.__e2e.enter0, wordsToLandMs:window.__e2e.playAt-window.__e2e.t0, cartridge: s.activeInstance.cartridge.manifest.cartridgeId + '@' + s.activeInstance.cartridge.manifest.version};} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.body.innerText.slice(0,600);})()
({writingAhead: document.body.innerText.match(/Writing the next chapter[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null, usage: document.body.innerText.match(/This world:[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null})

import('/engine/playerProbe.ts').then(m=>{const p=m.samplePlayer(); window.__e2e.walkedAt=Date.now(); return {before: window.__e2e.pose0, after: p, wordsToWalkedMs: window.__e2e.walkedAt-window.__e2e.t0};})

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<240;i++){if(!/Writing the next chapter/.test(document.body.innerText)) return {chapterStatusGoneAfterPlayMs: Date.now()-window.__e2e.playAt}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return 'chapter still writing';})()

note: Recorded run: after Build and play the app showed the BuiltPanel ('Your world is published' + an optional ENS name, shown because .env sets the lineage market) and waited for 'Enter the world'. The recorded run's poll had no step for it; the click was sent from a separate call 132.3 s after Build (publish itself took 2.5 s: cartridge createdAt 05:52:49.670Z vs Build click 05:52:47.137Z), and Play opened 282 ms after the click. The two panel actions above are that click, added for replay.
